totems.name: Cernunnos
totems.description: Converts 2 selected cards to Wild Cards
totems.flavor: He who wears the antlers walks between all worlds.

totems.name: Brigid
totems.description: Enhances 2 selected cards to Bonus Cards
totems.flavor: The sacred flame burns away weakness, leaving only strength.

totems.name: Lugh
totems.description: Enhances 2 selected cards to Mult Cards
totems.flavor: Lugh's many skills multiply into mastery.

totems.name: The Morrigan
totems.description: Destroys up to 2 selected cards
totems.flavor: She circles overhead — what she touches does not return.

totems.name: Danu
totems.description: Creates 2 random Rune cards
totems.flavor: The mother of all gods gives freely to those who seek the old ways.

totems.name: The Dagda
totems.description: Doubles current gold (max +$20)
totems.flavor: His cauldron never empties — abundance flows to the worthy.

totems.name: Ogma
totems.description: Increases rank of up to 2 selected cards by 1
totems.flavor: Ogma invented language; in his hands, a 9 becomes a 10.

totems.name: Manannán
totems.description: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Coin
totems.flavor: The sea lord changes the tide with a word.

totems.name: Áine
totems.description: 1 in 3 chance to add a random edition to a Púca
totems.flavor: Her blessing falls where it will — radiant and unpredictable.

totems.name: Nuada
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to an Ancient Card
totems.flavor: The king's silver hand remembers every play ever made.

totems.name: Epona
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to a Steel Card
totems.flavor: Epona's horse endures all roads — forged in fire, never broken.

totems.name: Balor
totems.description: Destroys 1 card, then doubles current gold
totems.flavor: What his eye strikes down — its worth flows back to the bearer.

totems.name: Ceridwen
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to a Glass Card
totems.flavor: From her cauldron comes wisdom — but wisdom breaks the careless.

totems.name: Taranis
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to a Runic Card
totems.flavor: The thunder god inscribes the rune — crackling with old power.

totems.name: Cú Chulainn
totems.description: Enhances 2 selected cards to Lucky Cards
totems.flavor: The champion's luck was forged in battle — never certain, always fierce.

totems.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill
totems.description: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Spear
totems.flavor: He who tasted the Salmon of Knowledge sees the shape of every hand.

totems.name: Arianrhod
totems.description: Creates 1 random Púca card
totems.flavor: She turns the silver wheel of stars — and something new falls into being.

totems.name: Rhiannon
totems.description: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Blood
totems.flavor: Her three birds of Rhiannon make the dead walk and the living sleep.

totems.name: Gofannon
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to a Gold Card
totems.flavor: The divine smith hammers gold into whatever you need.

totems.name: Sulis
totems.description: Converts up to 3 selected cards to Clover
totems.flavor: Her sacred spring turns all to verdant clover — deep as roots.

totems.name: Bran the Blessed
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to an Elemental (Fire) Card
totems.flavor: His head prophesied for eighty years — a fire that never dies.

totems.name: The Cailleach
totems.description: Enhances 1 selected card to a Bone Card
totems.flavor: The old woman of winter strips flesh from stone — what remains is essential.

totems.name: Court Knot
totems.description: Poker only: choose 2 cards; the second copies the first card's rank
totems.flavor: Two faces bow beneath one crown.

totems.name: Flush Weave
totems.description: Poker only: choose 3 cards; all copy the first card's suit
totems.flavor: Three streams enter one dark water.

totems.name: Royal Road
totems.description: Poker only: choose 5 cards; make them 10-J-Q-K-A in the first suit
totems.flavor: A dangerous road, but every step wears a crown.

totems.name: Clan Knot
totems.description: Rummy only: choose 3 cards; all copy the first card's rank
totems.flavor: Three names are bound into one household.

totems.name: Road Song
totems.description: Rummy only: choose 3 cards; make a same-suit 3-card Run from the first rank
totems.flavor: The first note shows the other two where to follow.

totems.name: Wild Bond
totems.description: Rummy only: make 2 selected cards Wild
totems.flavor: No guest is a stranger beneath the hill.

totems.name: Five Stones
totems.description: Cribbage only: turn 2 selected cards into 5s
totems.flavor: Five and five invite every court card to the count.

totems.name: Knob Charm
totems.description: Cribbage only: turn 1 selected card into a Jack
totems.flavor: The right Jack watches the Turn and waits.

totems.name: Pegging Ladder
totems.description: Cribbage only: make 4 selected cards a 3-4-5-6 sequence
totems.flavor: Four rungs climb toward fifteen and thirty-one.
